messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Request: one-time total reward amendment for L4 Backend candidate — Eli Navarro
Attachments: Eli_Navarro_Comp_Sheet.pdf

Marissa / Laura —

Quick ask: Eli Navarro (L4 backend IC) just surfaced a strong counteroffer from his current employer and is asking for a one-time retention package to proceed with Redwood. We confirmed headcount (open L4 backend role) and have room in the hiring flexibility pool, but comp is outside the standard band.

Proposal (one-time, not a band raise):
- $30,000 one-time sign-on cash (gross)
- 0.25% one-time equity refresh (RSU top-up vests pro-rata over 12 months)

Current offer summary (attached comp sheet):
- Base: $170,000
- Target bonus: 10%
- Equity: 0.6% initial grant
- Total OTE (current offer): ~ $190k + equity

Why this is urgent:
- Eli has a late-stage counter (money + retention bonus) — timeline tight, needs response by EOD Wednesday PST
- Candidate is highly rated by product & infra (impact on inference serving roadmap)

Ask: Marissa / Laura — can we approve this one-time amendment? If yes, we’ll route to Comp/Finance + Legal for formal offer letter update (DocuSign). If you need a smaller amount to make it approvable, please advise.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time total reward amendment for L4 Backend candidate — Eli Navarro

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 9:14 AM PST, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Marissa / Laura —
> 
> Quick ask: Eli Navarro (L4 backend IC) just surfaced a strong counteroffer from his current employer and is asking for a one-time retention package to proceed with Redwood...

Thanks Karthik —

A few quick clarifying questions before I greenlight:
- Confirm headcount is already authorized for this role (I see that it is, but double-checking finance tag).
- Is the 0.25% refresh intended as additional RSUs on top of the 0.6% or as a replacement? (Karthik: looks additive per comp sheet)
- Does this set a precedent for the team? We’re within single-digit exceptions but want to keep the ask narrow and one-time.

My instincts: I’m open to the cash + equity refresh but prefer a slightly smaller cash component to limit precedent exposure — e.g., $25k cash + 0.20% refresh. If Laura believes we need the full amount to close, say so. Assuming Laura + Comp OK, I want this routed to Finance (Markus) and People Ops (Neha) for final sign-off and Legal to update the offer language.

Please copy the candidate in the final communication once approvals are in place. Timeline: need final direction by EOD Wednesday.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Dir. Talent Acquisition | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time total reward amendment for L4 Backend candidate — Eli Navarro

Marissa / Karthik —

I reviewed Eli’s loop notes and the hiring packet. Short and firm: I support the full request ($30k cash + 0.25% one-time refresh).

Rationale:
- High-impact candidate for the inference runtime roadmap (mentions in interview feedback).
- We’re at risk of losing momentum on roadmap delivery if this hire slips 6+ months.
- Hiring flexibility fund exists for exactly this scenario; I’ll cover the allocation from my org budget.

Next steps I’m requesting:
1) Markus / Neha: please confirm finance/comp/legal are ok and process the updated offer.
2) Karthik: prepare an updated offer letter draft for Legal to review, include clear one-time language and pro-rata vesting schedule for the refresh.
3) Marissa: once approved, route to Eli + Lisa (talent agency) for signature.

Happy to jump on a quick call if needed. Approving now from hiring manager side.

—Laura
Laura Bennett | VP, Infrastructure Product | Redwood Inference
